ministry_names.legal_basis: 정부조직법 법률 제3854호 (effective 1987-01-01, 제29조② 장관은 국무위원으로 보하고, 제38조) in force at window start. Abolished by 법률 제4831호 (1994-12-23, 부칙 제2조①, merged with 교통부 into 건설교통부) and 대통령령 제14447호 (부칙 제2조, repealed the 건설부 직제). The office existed from 1961, so 최동섭's first spell (from 1987-12-15) is under the same name.

정부조직법 법률 제4831호 (effective 1994-12-23, 제29조②, 제40조 건설교통부, 부칙 제2조①) and 대통령령 제14447호 건설교통부와그소속기관직제. 해사 moved to 해양수산부 under 법률 제5153호 (1996-08-08, 제40조①). Continues after 1998-02-27 under 법률 제5529호 (main roster offices.json OF021).

spells.notes: 전두환-era minister still in office on 1988-02-25 (caretaker holdover). His predecessor 이규효 was relieved on the afternoon of 1987-12-14 after campaign remarks (사표 수리 or 의원면직, per the papers), and 최동섭, then 총무처 소청심사위원장, was named the same afternoon (임명발령) and given the 임명장 on the morning of 1987-12-15. The start follows the 임명장 day, which ko.wikipedia also gives, hence medium (the 대한민국사연표 files the change under 1987-12-14). The 김정렬 cabinet handed in blanket resignations after the last 국무회의 of the 5th Republic on 1988-02-24, and 노태우 accepted them on the morning of 1988-02-25, before giving the new cabinet its 임명장 the same morning. He was one of the seven sitting ministers kept by the President-elect (named 1988-02-19), so he was reappointed that morning (next spell). The spell is split at the reappointment, as justice.ext88.json (정해창), interior.ext88.json (이상희), foreign.ext88.json (최광수) and finance.ext88.json (사공일) do for the same event. end_reason 'resigned' records the accepted blanket resignation. ko.wikipedia lists him as one row (제19대, 1987-12-15 to 1988-12-05). Age 52 and 全北南原 per 조선일보 1987-12-15 (1987121500239101011). No gazette files exist before 2001. Person sources are ko.wikipedia '최동섭' (secondary), revid 39451117, https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=39451117, snapshot roster/sources/land/ext88/bios/wiki_최동섭.json (accessed 2026-09-26T12:52:49-0400), lead '(崔同燮, 1935년 ~)' and Wikidata Q28700115 (secondary), https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q28700115, snapshot roster/sources/land/ext88/bios/wikidata_Q28700115.json (accessed 2026-09-26T12:52:49-0400), P569 birth 1935-00-00, P21 sex Q6581097. ko.wikipedia and Wikidata give birth year 1935 only, so birth_date is null.

spells.notes: Reappointed on inauguration day. The President-elect named him on 1988-02-19 as one of seven ministers of the 5th-Republic cabinet kept in the first 이현재 cabinet (외무 최광수, 내무 이상희, 재무 사공일, 법무 정해창, 체육 조상호, 건설 최동섭, 체신 오명). On the morning of 1988-02-25 the outgoing cabinet's resignations were accepted and the PM 서리 and the new 국무위원, the retained ones included, received 임명장 at the 청와대 (중앙일보 counts 23 국무위원, 조선일보 p.3 counts 24). No source names 최동섭 individually at that ceremony. The reading that he was newly appointed rests on the accepted resignations and on these counts, as in the peer ext88 files. Replaced in the 1988-12-05 전면개각. That morning the whole 이현재 cabinet handed in resignations at an 8 a.m. 임시국무회의, and the new ministers, 박승 among them, received the 임명장 in the afternoon, so the handover is same-day. ko.wikipedia ends him on 1988-12-05. Person sources are ko.wikipedia '최동섭' (secondary), revid 39451117, https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=39451117, snapshot roster/sources/land/ext88/bios/wiki_최동섭.json (accessed 2026-09-26T12:52:49-0400), lead '(崔同燮, 1935년 ~)' and Wikidata Q28700115 (secondary), https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q28700115, snapshot roster/sources/land/ext88/bios/wikidata_Q28700115.json (accessed 2026-09-26T12:52:49-0400), P569 birth 1935-00-00, P21 sex Q6581097. ko.wikipedia and Wikidata give birth year 1935 only, so birth_date is null.

spells.notes: 대통령 경제수석비서관 when named in the 1988-12-05 전면개각. The 임명장 was given the same afternoon. spells.notes: 한국주택공사 사장 (retired army 중장, former 국방차관) when named on 1989-07-19. Appointed and given the 임명장 the same morning (11:00). Replaced on 1990-09-19 in a three-ministry reshuffle that the chronology describes as tied to the flood response and the 건설부 staff's 'insubordination' over the 직제 reorganisation of 1990-08-20. The new ministers were notified before dawn and given the 임명장 that morning before the public announcement (부산일보 1990-09-19), so the handover is same-day. ko.wikipedia gives birth year 1931 only (died 2019), and Wikidata also has the year only, so birth_date is null. spells.notes: 경제기획원 차관 when named on the afternoon of 1991-02-18 (수서 reshuffle). Given the 임명장 on the morning of 1991-02-19 and took up office that day. The start follows the 임명장 day, hence medium. ko.wikipedia gives 1991-02-18. Replaced in the reshuffle announced on the afternoon of 1991-12-19. He held his 이임식 at 15:30 that day and left the 과천 building (한겨레 1991-12-20), and 경향신문 reports the 청와대 explanation that he left for health reasons. His successor received the 임명장 on the morning of 1991-12-20. No dated 사표 수리 or 면직 was found, so the end is the successor's 임명장 day (inferred_from_successor), as in the main land file (김현미). 1991-12-19, the 이임식 day, is the alternative and is what ko.wikipedia gives. Birth date from ko.wikipedia and Wikidata (both secondary). Gender not stated in any source consulted (Wikidata Q12612816 has no P21). Person sources are ko.wikipedia '이진설' (secondary), revid 41920787, https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=41920787, snapshot roster/sources/land/ext88/bios/wiki_이진설.json (accessed 2026-09-26T12:52:53-0400), lead '(李鎭卨, 1939년 3월 25일 ~ 2019년 2월 17일, 경북 구미)' and Wikidata Q12612816 (secondary), https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q12612816, snapshot roster/sources/land/ext88/bios/wikidata_Q12612816.json (accessed 2026-09-26T12:52:53-0400), P569 birth 1939-03-25, P21 sex none. spells.notes: 국세청장 when named on the afternoon of 1991-12-19 and given the 임명장 on the morning of 1991-12-20 (the start, hence medium). ko.wikipedia gives 1991-12-19. 노태우 appointee who stayed on as caretaker after 김영삼 took office on 1993-02-25. He still went to work as 건설부장관 on 1993-02-25 (조선일보 1993-02-26 p.7), the new cabinet was announced on 1993-02-26 and received its 임명장 that afternoon, and 한겨레 describes the outgoing economic ministers as leaving office on the 26th. The end is 1993-02-26 (same-day handover). ko.wikipedia gives 1993-02-25 (the end of the 노태우 term), which these reports contradict. Birth date from ko.wikipedia and Wikidata (secondary). Person sources are ko.wikipedia '서영택 (공무원)' (secondary), revid 41920791, https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=41920791, snapshot roster/sources/land/ext88/bios/wiki_서영택_공무원_.json (accessed 2026-09-26T12:52:54-0400), lead '(徐榮澤, 1939년 4월 23일 ~)' and Wikidata Q12601056 (secondary), https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q12601056, snapshot roster/sources/land/ext88/bios/wikidata_Q12601056.json (accessed 2026-09-26T12:52:54-0400), P569 birth 1939-04-23, P21 sex Q6581097. [verifier] end_confidence set to medium. The value 1993-02-26 is kept, but one contemporary report contradicts it. 중앙일보 1993-02-25 says the outgoing cabinet's resignations were submitted and all accepted on 02-25, which would make 02-25 his last day, while 국민일보 1993-02-24 has the economic ministers' farewells planned for the morning of 02-26 and 서영택 signing papers up to 02-25. finance.ext88.verified.json rates 이용만's identical end medium for the same reason. The date is not changed. Sources are in verification.changes. [verifier, resume audit] Relabeled disputed on resume. The contrary report (중앙일보 1993-02-25, all resignations accepted on 02-25) states a fact, not a dating convention, so it is kept as a dispute rather than a considered conflict. 매일경제 1993-02-24 p.2 gives the 총무처 view that the outgoing ministers need not resign and leave when successors are appointed, and 조선일보 1993-02-24 p.3 says the 6공 ministers serve until successors are formally appointed. With 조선일보 1993-02-26 p.7 (he worked on 02-25) and 한겨레 1993-02-26 p.6 (economic ministers leave office on the 26th), they support the kept value. Both sides are in end_sources and verification.disputes.

spells.notes: First 건설부장관 of the 김영삼 government, named and given the 임명장 on the afternoon of 1993-02-26. The papers differ on his post when named (동아일보 '건설부차관', 매일경제, 한국일보 and 세계일보 '국토개발연구원 원장'). Removed on the afternoon of 1993-03-08, eleven days into office, over his property holdings. The 청와대 spokesman said he was dismissed (해임) after an internal inquiry (조선일보, 한국일보, 중앙일보), while 중앙일보 also lists him among ministers who had signalled they would resign. end_reason follows the official statement. He held his 이임식 the same afternoon and 고병우 received the 임명장 that afternoon, so the handover is same-day. Birth date from ko.wikipedia and Wikidata (secondary). Gender not stated in any source consulted (Wikidata Q27951900 has no P21). Person sources are ko.wikipedia '허재영 (1934년)' (secondary), revid 40523156, https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=40523156, snapshot roster/sources/land/ext88/bios/wiki_허재영_1934년_.json (accessed 2026-09-26T12:52:55-0400), lead '(許在榮, {{출생일|1934|9|29}} ~)' and Wikidata Q27951900 (secondary), https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q27951900, snapshot roster/sources/land/ext88/bios/wikidata_Q27951900.json (accessed 2026-09-26T12:52:55-0400), P569 birth 1934-09-29, P21 sex none. [verifier] gender set to M. The report on his dismissal lists an apartment held in his wife's name (부인명의 아파트). Sources are in verification.changes.

spells.notes: 토지개발공사 사장 when named in the 12·21 개각 of 1993, given the 임명장 at 09:00 on 1993-12-22 (the start, hence medium). ko.wikipedia gives 1993-12-21. The last 건설부장관. 법률 제4831호 merged 건설부 and 교통부 into 건설교통부 and, under 부칙 제2조①, carried over their staff except 정무직, so he did not become 건설교통부장관. The end follows the office's last day in offices_1988.json (1994-12-22), as epb.ext88.json and finance.ext88.json do for the same act. In fact the act was passed and promulgated on the afternoon of 1994-12-23. He attended the 임시국무회의 that afternoon, at which the whole cabinet handed in resignations, and held his 이임식 that day, combined with a ceremony for the dissolution of 건설부 (한겨레 1994-12-24). 1994-12-23 is therefore the alternative end (see issues). ko.wikipedia gives 1994-12-23. The same person later served as 내무부장관 from 1995-12-21 (interior.ext88.json). Birth date and gender (남) from the NA record. The birth date agrees with ko.wikipedia. Person sources are ko.wikipedia '김우석 (1936년)' (secondary), revid 42209274, https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=42209274, snapshot roster/sources/land/ext88/bios/wiki_김우석_1936년_.json (accessed 2026-09-26T09:43:50-0400), lead '(金佑錫, 1936년 10월 15일~2013년 9월 11일)' and Wikidata Q130539921 (secondary), https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q130539921, snapshot roster/sources/land/ext88/bios/wikidata_Q130539921.json (accessed 2026-09-26T12:52:57-0400), P569 birth none, P21 sex none.

spells.notes: First 건설교통부장관. He was 교통부장관 (transport lineage, from 1993-12-22) when 교통부 and 건설부 were merged on 1994-12-23. 부칙 제2조① of 법률 제4831호 excludes 정무직 from the carry-over, so a new appointment was needed. He was named on the afternoon of 1994-12-23 and received the 임명장 on the morning of 1994-12-24, with his 취임식 at 14:00 that day. The start follows the 임명장 day, which the 국토교통부 page and the archived 건설교통부 page also print, hence medium. reorg_continuation and reappointed_on_reorg are true because his cabinet tenure ran on from the predecessor ministry 교통부 into the merged ministry, as finance.ext88.json does for 홍재형. The previous spell is in the transport lineage, not in this file. Replaced in the 12·20 개각 of 1995. The ministers had handed in resignations at the 1995-12-19 국무회의 (한국일보 1995-12-20), the reshuffle was announced on 1995-12-20 and the successor received the 임명장 at 09:00 on 1995-12-21. The ministry pages end him on 1995-12-20 by their day-before convention. The end is the successor's 임명장 day (inferred_from_successor). 한겨레 (1995-12-21 p.6) mentions speculation that he might run in the 1996 general election, but no source found shows that he did, so end_reason is replaced. Also 체신부장관 in 1987-1988 (a different lineage). Birth date 1940-03-21 from ko.wikipedia and Wikidata, as in science.verified.json. The archived 건설교통부 약력 page prints 1940-03-31 (see issues). Person sources are ko.wikipedia '오명 (정치인)' (secondary), revid 41920780, https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=41920780, snapshot roster/sources/land/ext88/bios/wiki_오명_정치인_.json (accessed 2026-09-25T13:19:54-0400), lead '(吳明, 1940년 3월 21일~)' and Wikidata Q12607825 (secondary), https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q12607825, snapshot roster/sources/land/ext88/bios/wikidata_Q12607825.json (accessed 2026-09-26T12:52:57-0400), P569 birth 1940-03-21, P21 sex Q6581097.

spells.notes: Kim Young-sam appointee who stayed on as caretaker after the 1998-02-25 inauguration until the first Kim Dae-jung cabinet was appointed on 1998-03-03. Birth date not found (no ko.wikipedia biography page).

issues.desc: Convention for the seven ministers reappointed at the 1988-02-25 transition (외무 최광수, 내무 이상희, 재무 사공일, 법무 정해창, 체육 조상호, 건설 최동섭, 체신 오명). This file splits 최동섭 into a 전두환 spell ending 1988-02-25 (end_reason resigned, the accepted blanket resignation) and a 노태우 spell from 1988-02-25, as justice, interior, foreign and finance ext88 files do. sports.ext88.json keeps 조상호 as one continuous spell. ko.wikipedia has one row for 최동섭 (1987-12-15 to 1988-12-05). The assembler should use one convention for all seven and may want a flag joining the pair.

Announcement day against 임명장 day. In seven changes the appointment was announced (or 발령) on one day and the 임명장 given the next: 1987-12-14/15 (최동섭), 1991-02-18/19 (이진설), 1991-12-19/20 (서영택), 1993-12-21/22 (김우석), 1994-12-23/24 (오명), 1995-12-20/21 (추경석), 1997-03-05/06 (이환균, main file). Starts follow the 임명장 day, which the 국토교통부 and archived 건설교통부 pages print and which the peer ext88 files use for the same reshuffles, and are medium. nomination_date is the announcement day and outcome_date the 임명장 day. Where no dated relief of the outgoing minister was found, his end is the successor's 임명장 day (inferred_from_successor), following the main land file. ko.wikipedia differs as follows: 이상희 end 1991-02-19 (wiki 1991-02-18), 이진설 start 1991-02-19 (wiki 1991-02-18), 이진설 end 1991-12-20 (wiki 1991-12-19), 서영택 start 1991-12-20 (wiki 1991-12-19), 서영택 end 1993-02-26 (wiki 1993-02-25), 고병우 end 1993-12-22 (wiki 1993-12-21), 김우석 start 1993-12-22 (wiki 1993-12-21), 김우석 end 1994-12-22 (wiki 1994-12-23).

김우석's end. The file ends him on 1994-12-22, the last day of 건설부 in offices_1988.json, as epb.ext88.json and finance.ext88.json do for the same act. 법률 제4831호 was passed by the Assembly and promulgated on the afternoon of 1994-12-23 (동아일보 1994-12-24 p.2), and 김우석 attended the 임시국무회의 that afternoon and held his 이임식 that day (조선일보 1994-12-24 p.3, 한겨레 1994-12-24 p.5), so on a strict last-day-in-office reading his end is 1994-12-23 (also the ko.wikipedia value). The one-day vacancy of 건설교통부 on 1994-12-23 (continuity) depends on this choice.

이진설's end is 1991-12-20 (successor's 임명장 day, inferred_from_successor). He held his 이임식 at 15:30 on 1991-12-19, right after the announcement, and left the building (한겨레 1991-12-20), so 1991-12-19 is the alternative, and ko.wikipedia gives it. The same pattern (이임식 on the announcement day, 임명장 of the successor the next morning) may apply to 고병우 (1993-12-21/22), 오명 (1995-12-20/21) and 추경석 (1997-03-05/06), for whom no dated 이임식 was found.

오명's birth date. ko.wikipedia and Wikidata Q12607825 give 1940-03-21, as does science.verified.json. The archived 건설교통부 약력 page (moct.go.kr History_popup_01, Wayback 20021218043145) prints '생년월일 : 1940년 3월 31일'. The file uses 1940-03-21 for consistency with the main roster. A primary record should settle it.

오명 has reorg_continuation true and reappointed_on_reorg true, with the predecessor spell (교통부장관 from 1993-12-22) in the transport lineage, which has no file yet. The assembler should link the two spells across lineages as for 홍재형 (epb to finance).

Gender is null for 이상희, 이진설 and 허재영 because no source consulted states it (their Wikidata items have no P21 and they are not in the NA member file). interior.ext88.json records 이상희 (the same person) as M. The other holders take gender from Wikidata P21 or the NA record.
Birth dates rest on secondary sources except 김우석 (NA record) and 추경석 (archived 건설교통부 약력 page). 최동섭 and 권영각 have birth years only (1935 and 1931 in ko.wikipedia and Wikidata), so birth_date is null.

허재영's post when named differs between papers (동아일보 1993-02-26 '건설부차관', 매일경제 1993-02-26 '국토개발연구원 원장', 한국일보 and 세계일보 1993-02-27 '국토개발연구원장'). His exit is recorded as dismissed (해임) per the 청와대 spokesman (조선일보, 한국일보 1993-03-09 and 중앙일보 1993-03-08), although 중앙일보 also groups him with ministers who had signalled they would resign.

The 대한민국사연표 entry pages (step 7) returned only the dated title, and five of them timed out, so the chronology citations use the day-list snapshots from step 3, which carry the same titles. The entry for 1987-12-14 reads '위명', a typo for 임명.

vacancies.note: 1994-12-23, the day 법률 제4831호 took effect (promulgated that afternoon). 건설부 closed (office end 1994-12-22 in offices_1988.json) and 건설교통부 had no minister until 오명's 임명장 on the morning of 1994-12-24. 부칙 제2조① carried over the staff of 건설부 and 교통부 except 정무직, so neither ministry's 장관 or 차관 moved over. The first 건설교통부 차관, 柳常悅 (건설부 차관 before the merger), was named in the 차관급 인사 reported on 1994-12-26 (중앙일보 1994-12-26 profile, BigKinds 01100901.19941226155742003), and 매일경제 1994-12-24 p.7 still treats the post as open. No source naming a 장관 직무대행 for the day was found (News Library and BigKinds searches for '건설교통부 직무대행', '건설교통부 차관' and '건설교통부차관', 1994-12-22..31, step07.json). If 김우석's end is read as 1994-12-23 (see issues), the vacancy is only the part of 1994-12-23 after the act took effect.

Every month from 1987-12 to 1998-03 was searched in the Naver News Library (동아, 경향, 매경, 조선, 한겨레) and in BigKinds (서울신문, 한국일보, 중앙일보, 국민일보, 세계일보 and others) for 건설부장관, and from 1994-12 for 건설교통부장관 and 건교부장관, and the person names printed right before the title were counted (roster/scripts/land_ext88_verify_03_monthly_tally.py, roster/sources/land/ext88/verify/monthly_tally_NL.json and monthly_tally_BK.json, raw responses in roster/sources/land/ext88/verify/nl_tally/ and bk_tally/, summary roster/sources/land/ext88/verify/tally_summary.json). The News Library tally covers 124 months and the BigKinds tally 124. In 121 of the 121 months from 1988-02 to 1998-02 at least one archive names the holder that the file puts in office that month. Counted per holder, the months of his tenure inside the window in which at least one archive names him before the title are 최동섭 10 of 11, 박승 8 of 8, 권영각 15 of 15, 이상희 6 of 6, 이진설 11 of 11, 서영택 15 of 15, 허재영 2 of 2, 고병우 10 of 10, 김우석 13 of 13, 오명 13 of 13, 추경석 16 of 16, 이환균 12 of 12. A holder can be missed only in the month he left, when the news names his successor.

Names other than the month's holder that reach a count of 2 in one archive were reviewed one by one (roster/sources/land/ext88/verify/tally_unexpected_review.json). None is an unlisted 건설부 or 건설교통부 minister. 238 name-month pairs were reviewed and classed as 14 foreign, 24 former, 4 holder, 2 next, 3 other, 191 word. 'former' are earlier ministers named with 前/전 or in reports on past events, 'holder' are fragments of the month's holder, 'foreign' are other countries' construction ministers, 'other' are non-ministers (a TV drama character, an award recipient, a litigant), 'next' is the successor of 1998-03, 'word' are common words or OCR fragments. The 'word' tokens were read in their saved context (tally_unexpected_context.json).

Ordinal numbering from sources the builder did not use. 동아일보 1993-02-26 p.3 calls 허재영 the 제25대 건설부장관 after 24 earlier ministers, and 한국경제 1994-09-02 calls 김종호 (1982-01 to 1983-10, name misprinted 金宗統 in that obituary) the 16대. The eight ordinals 17 to 24 are then filled by exactly the eight persons between them in the file and in Namu Wiki (김성배, 이규효, 최동섭, 박승, 권영각, 이상희, 이진설, 서영택), so no 건설부장관 between 1983 and 1993 is missing, and 최동섭's reappointment of 1988-02-25 was not counted as a new ordinal. 한겨레 1994-12-24 p.4 calls 오명 the first (초대) 건설교통부장관, so no one held that office before him. Sources in verification.evidence under 'completeness'.

Survival through reshuffles in which the land holder did not change. In the 1990-03-17/19 reshuffle 서울신문 1990-03-18 lists 권영각 among the ministers kept, and 서울신문 1990-03-20 calls him the only economic minister kept. After the reshuffles of 1990-12-27 and 1991-05-27 the monthly tallies name 이상희 in 1991-01 and 이진설 in 1991-06, and the 대통령기록관 schedule has 이진설 건설부장관 at the 주암댐 ceremony on 1991-05-10. Through the reshuffles of 1992-03-30/31, 1992-06-26 and 1992-10-09, 서영택 hosted former ministers on 1992-03-16, attended the 경부고속철도 groundbreaking as 건설장관 on 1992-06-30 (서울신문 1992-07-01) and is named in the tallies up to 1993-02. The tallies name 김우석 in the months after the reshuffles of 1994-04-30 and 1994-10-05, and 오명 after that of 1995-05-16. After the reshuffle of 1996-08-08/09 매일경제 1996-08-09 speaks of '유임된 박재윤 통산부 장관이나 추경석 건교부 장관', and the tallies name 추경석 in 1997-01, after that of 1996-12-20. After the reshuffle of 1997-08-05 매일경제 1997-08-06 lists 이환균 among the economic ministers kept, the 대통령기록관 schedule has 이환균 건설교통부장관 at the KAL crash meeting on 1997-08-06, and the tallies name him in 1997-12, after the reshuffle of 1997-11-19.

Elections. No holder left office to run in the 1988-04-26 or 1992-03-24 general elections, the 1995-06-27 local elections or the 1996-04-11 general election. 최동섭 was touring 강원 projects as minister during the 1988 campaign (동아일보 1988-04-11), 서영택 hosted former ministers on 1992-03-16, and the tallies name 최동섭, 서영택, 오명 and 추경석 as current minister in the months on both sides of each election. 오명 was expected in 1995-12 to leave the cabinet to run in 과천·의왕 (조선일보 1995-12-18 and other reports found by the targeted searches, roster/sources/land/ext88/verify/targeted.json key E_1996). He was replaced in the 12·20 개각, and on 1995-12-26 신한국당 announced that he would not run (조선일보 and 매일경제 1995-12-27), so end_reason replaced stands. The searches for 건설부장관 or 건설교통부장관 with 출마 before the other elections (keys E_1988, E_1992, E_1995) found only former ministers (이규효, 김성배, 최종완) as candidates.

Transitions. For 1988-02-25, the seven ministers kept (최동섭 among them) are named in 조선일보 1988-02-18 p.1, and the new president gave 23 cabinet members their 임명장 on the 25th (한국경제 1988-02-26), after the 5th-Republic cabinet's resignations reached him that morning (조선일보 1988-02-25 p.1). The 1993-02-26 transition is covered under the 서영택 and 허재영 spells. Among offices renamed or merged, 건설부 and 교통부 were merged into 건설교통부 on 1994-12-23 (전자신문 and 중도일보 1994-12-24), which the 김우석 and 오명 spells handle. The 1996-08-08 creation of 해양수산부 took 해사 away from 건설교통부 without renaming it, and 추경석 stayed (매일경제 1996-08-09).
